name: Turn Start
description: Increments the mission year, publishes EvTurnStarted, and refreshes unit moves

name: Resource Collection
description: Collects resources from all bases for each faction

name: Base Growth
description: Spends each base's nutrient stockpile: grows a pop at the threshold, starves one when the stockpile goes negative. Must run after ResourceCollection has banked nutrients, and before BaseProduction so an item whose pop cost would empty the base is judged against the size the base actually ends the turn at

name: Unit Support
description: Charges home-unit mineral support against this turn's mineral bank; disbands units the base cannot support. Must run after ResourceCollection has banked minerals and before MineralConversion

name: Mineral Conversion
description: Converts minerals into other resources. Must run after UnitSupport has taken its share and before IncomeCollection / ResearchAccumulation drain econ and labs

name: Income Collection
description: Collects econ stockpile from all bases and transfers income to the faction energy pool

name: Upkeep
description: Retires expired deploy records and charges facility energy upkeep against the faction treasury; must run after IncomeCollection has banked this turn's econ

name: Population
description: Processes population changes and drone/talent balance

name: World Events
description: Handles random world events like mindworms and fungus

name: Victory Condition Checks
description: Checks if any faction has achieved victory

name: Player Actions
description: Executes pending unit orders at the end of the turn

name: Mood
description: Commits pending drone riots and golden ages after the player has had a chance to respond

name: Turn End
description: Finalizes the end of the turn
